template_name: Panzer III Ausf H Tank Platoon
historical_context: Panzer III Ausf H with short 50mm gun was the primary German battle tank in North Africa in 1941. Balanced design with good armor, firepower, and mobility. Equipped Panzer-Regiment 8 during Operation Battleaxe.

Panzer III Ausf H.notes: Balanced medium tank. Effective against most British tanks except Matilda II.

strengths: Good balance of armor, speed, and firepower
50mm gun effective against most British cruiser tanks
Good for mobile warfare and combined arms
weaknesses: Short 50mm gun struggles against Matilda II heavy armor
30mm frontal armor vulnerable to British 2-pdr and 25-pdr
Sand and heat affected mechanical reliability
Limited fuel range in desert operations
tactical_notes.typical_deployment: Main battle line. Combined arms operations with Panzer IV (HE support) and infantry. Use speed and tactics to avoid frontal engagements with Matildas. Coordinate with 88mm FlaK guns for anti-tank support.

phase_6_data_source.operational_at_battleaxe: ~50 of 80 total operational tanks were Pz.III
phase_6_data_source.notes: Lost 50 tanks at Fort Capuzzo on 15 June 1941
